blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An American man was arrested in Pampanga following an alleged altercation at a mall where he repeatedly harassed Filipinos and called a woman an “animal,” the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said Wednesday. In a statement, the BI said 69-year-old Patrick Ndukwuegbulam Obison, was apprehended on Sept. 24 in Barangay Balibago, Angeles City, Pampanga.
